Sudowoodo

Rock

Johto · Generation 2

Sudowoodo is a Rock-type Imitation Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 1.2 m tall and weighs 38 kg. It evolves from Bonsly. Its highest base stat is Defense (115), with a base stat total of 410.
